description: Append markup annotations (ISO 32000-1 §12.5) to an existing PDF as a non-destructive incremental update (original bytes preserved). Types: text (sticky note), highlight | underline | strikeout | squiggly, square | circle, line (needs start/end), freetext, link (needs url — http:, https: or mailto:; the rect is the clickable area). Each needs a 0-based `page` and `rect` [x1,y1,x2,y2]; optional contents, color, opacity, title and type-specific fields. VISUAL OVERLAY ONLY — nothing is removed or redacted (covered text stays extractable). Encrypted sources → ENCRYPTED_SOURCE (decrypt_pdf first).

annotations.description: Markup / drawing annotations to add. Each is attached to a 0-based page index.

oneOf.description: Hex (e.g. "#ffcc00") or PDF operator string ("R G B", or "C M Y K" for DeviceCMYK), each operand 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

icon.description: type='text': icon name (Note, Comment, Key, Help, Insert…).

oneOf.description: Hex (e.g. "#ffcc00") or PDF operator string ("R G B", or "C M Y K" for DeviceCMYK), each operand 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

open.description: type='text': whether the note pop-up starts open.

page.description: 0-based page index to attach the annotation to.

rect.description: Annotation rectangle [x1, y1, x2, y2] in PDF user-space points.

url.description: type='link' (required): target of the /URI action — http:, https: or mailto: only, no control characters. The `rect` is the clickable area; no visible appearance is drawn.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the PDF inline; 'file' writes it inside the PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (SECURITY_VIOLATION when the sandbox is not configured).

outputPath.description: Required when outputMode='file'. Relative path inside the sandbox; must end with .pdf (no absolute paths, no '..').

name: annotate_pdf

outputSchema.description: Result of a PDF-producing tool. base64 mode: the PDF arrives as an embedded `resource` content block (not duplicated here); file mode: `filePath` (and `url` when the operator maps the sandbox to a public base URL).

url.description: Public URL of the file (file mode, only when PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_BASE_URL is set): base URL + sandbox-relative path, percent-encoded.

title: Annotate PDF (markup / drawing)
